name: Rod N. Armande
tagline: Top rated Immigration attorney in Los Angeles, California
education: Western State University College of Law
about: Rod N. Armande, the founder and principal attorney at Rod Armande Law in Los Angeles, California, has been a steadfast advocate for immigrant communities. With decades of dedication to justice, he has made it his mission to fight for the rights of his clients both in the courtroom and in their everyday lives.

In 2023, Mr. Armande broadened his practice to include personal injury law, applying his formidable skills in negotiation, advocacy and trial work to cases involving automobile accidents, rideshare incidents, bus and truck collisions, pedestrian injuries, slip-and-fall accidents, catastrophic injuries and wrongful death claims. His personal experiences with the challenges of facing insurers without representation fuel his commitment to ensuring that others never have to face such battles alone.

Since embarking on his legal career, Mr. Armande has assisted over 3,000 individuals in navigating the complexities of immigration and personal injury law. He has earned a reputation as a tireless champion for immigrant communities and injured clients alike. His primary goal is to deliver exceptional and diligent legal services, ensuring that each client receives the personalized attention they deserve. He is known for his integrity and relentless work ethic, fighting passionately for his clients' rights and striving to secure the best possible results. His impressive track record of successful cases is a testament to his ability to not only advocate effectively but also to win when it matters most.

Mr. Armande's journey began with a Bachelor of Arts in world history from the University of Georgia in 2009, followed by a Juris Doctor from Western State College of Law in 2016. He initially concentrated on immigration law, where he has helped thousands of immigrants secure legal status and successfully defended many more from deportation.

A true consummate professional, Mr. Armande's dedication and results have not gone unnoticed. Rated "Superb" on Avvo, he has received numerous prestigious honors, including being named to the National Trial Lawyers' Top 40 Under 40 list for civil plaintiffs in 2024 and 2025 and the Top 10 list for immigration law in the same years. Additionally, he has been recognized by Lawyers of Distinction for his work in immigration and personal injury law in 2024 and 2025.
